records.detail: The Reserve Bank of Malawi's audited statements for the year ended 31 December 2025 say the Bank sets a benchmark of the Merrill Lynch 1-3 Year US Government Bond Index (80%) and the Merrill Lynch 3-month US Dollar Deposit Offer Rate (20%) for foreign reserves 'being managed by external fund managers', allocates those managers a risk budget, and put the value of the external funds at K3,880 million as at 31 December 2025 (2024: K3,740 million). The credit-risk counterparty table in the same note carries one fund-manager row, 'Crown Agents Fund manager', country United Kingdom, counterparty limit 'No Limit', 5.00% of exposure, carrying amount K3,880 million - the identical figure - listed separately from the three 'Crown Agents Bank Limited' banking rows. The report gives no city, so the head office is left null and only the United Kingdom stated in the table is recorded. The same wording appears in the Annual Report and Accounts 2025 (ContentID 63680).
records.source_title: Reserve Bank of Malawi, Consolidated and Separate Annual Financial Statements for the year ended 31 December 2025 (interest-rate risk note and credit-risk counterparty table, notes 3 and 37)
records.quote: The value of the external funds being managed by the external fund managers stood at K3 880 million as at 31 December 2025

blanks.note: NEAR-MISS, now stronger and needs a decision above me. The 2025 annual report does not exist on centralbank.org.ls (the corporate-reports page lists annual reports only to 2024), so I read the next document instead: Central Bank of Lesotho, Audited Financial Statements for the year ended 31 December 2025 (CBL-AFS-2025.pdf, 63 pages). The file is a scan and extracts no text, so I rasterised it at 170 dpi and OCR'd all 63 pages. Note 37 'Financial instruments and risk management', credit risk analysis, carries the same counterparty rows as 2024 - 'Crown Agents' GBP 119 and USD 128, 'Bank of N.Y' USD 698 / ZAR 7,004, 'World Bank RAMP' USD 44,650 under Fixed deposits (2024: 54,703), 'United States-RAMP' M1,932,669 thousand under Treasury notes and bonds - and NEW this year a row immediately beneath it reading 'United States-internally Managed' M4,610,394 thousand (2024 comparative: United States-RAMP 2,133,975 and United States-internally Managed 978,028). The table therefore classifies the Bank's US treasury notes and bonds by who manages them, RAMP against internally managed, which is the strongest evidence this row has had for Lesotho. But it is still a table label in a counterparty table with rating and collateral columns, not a sentence: I grepped the whole OCR for 'external', 'externally', 'outsourc', 'third part', 'Reserve Advisory', 'mandate', 'advis' and 'fund manager' and no sentence anywhere says the World Bank, RAMP or Crown Agents manages any portfolio. The only management sentences are about the Bank's own portfolio managers and its own statutory mandate to manage the reserves. I also read the Bank's own reserves-management page (centralbank.org.ls/index.php/financial-markets-about/598-reserves-management): it names nobody and attributes the function to the Department of Financial Markets under section 6(f). Filed as refused under the no-upgrade rule; if the project will accept the 'RAMP' versus 'internally Managed' row pair as the source distinguishing externally from internally managed money, this is a World Bank RAMP record of M1,932,669 thousand at 31 December 2025 waiting to be filed.

National Bank of Ethiopia Annual Report 2023/24 (nbe.gov.et/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/Annual-Report-2023-24.pdf, 261 pages, 39 MB). The audited Financial Statements for the Year Ended 30 June 2024 run from p.100 and are scanned images that extract no text, so I rasterised pp.100-210 at 150 dpi and OCR'd all 111 pages (231,000 characters). Grepped for externally managed, external manager, RAMP, Reserve Advisory, World Bank, IBRD, Crown Agents, BlackRock, Amundi, PIMCO, UBS, Wellington, Nomura, Franklin, fund manager, custodian and portfolio managed. Nothing. IBRD appears only in note 9(f) 'Cash and cash equivalents' as a one-year time deposit counterparty of Birr 2,930,459,469 alongside TDB and Afreximbank, and in a liabilities table. No external manager, no custodian, no RAMP mandate anywhere in the notes or the accounting-policy notes. The separate 'audited financial statement june 2024' page on nbe.gov.et returns 404 to curl and client_error to WebFetch, but it would be the same statements that are reproduced in this report.

Banque Centrale de la Republique de Guinee: TWO documents read for the year ended 31 December 2023 - 'BCRG Rapport IFRS 2023' (bcrg-guinee.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/BCRG-Rapport-IFRS-2023.pdf, 93,000 characters of text) and 'BCRG Rapport audit des etats financiers au 31122023' (.../2026/02/BCRG-Rapport-audit-des-etats-financiers-au-31122023.pdf). Grepped both for gestionnaire, gestion deleguee, geree par, externe, RAMP, Banque mondiale, World Bank, BIRD, IBRD, Crown Agents, BlackRock, Amundi, depositaire, mandat and conservateur. No outside reserve manager. Note 3.7 on operating segments puts 'la gestion des reserves de change et des activites avec l'etranger' inside the head office as one of three divisions of the Bank itself. The only depositaire hits are a Dubai gold refiner/depositary (3.1 tonnes, with a December 2024 dispute) and 'depositaires en or monetaire agrees' - a gold-custodian lead for the custodian row, not this one. 'Primes gestionnaires' is a revenue line, not a manager's name. The securities portfolio note 2325 lists only equity participations (Afreximbank, AfricaRe, Societe Monetique de Guinee, BNIG, AFC).

Those local-currency placements are a different arrangement from the Crown Agents foreign-reserves mandate and no firm is named against them.
